invariants: Every ID is unique inside its registry.
Every attack references an existing live or graveyard hypothesis.
Every registered attack ID exists in the modular attack ledgers.
Every literature reference used by a hypothesis exists in references.json.
A reference support list may name only live hypotheses.
OPEN never means proved, probably true, or novel.
PROVED requires reproducibility R5 and an independently checkable proof artifact.
Destroyed and rejected hypotheses remain permanently addressable.
Mutually incompatible OPEN hypotheses are permitted and must not be presented as simultaneously true.
